title: Acadia To Participate in UBS Global Healthcare Conference
summary: Acadia Healthcare to take part in the 2025 UBS Global Healthcare Conference on November 9-12 in Palm Beach Gardens, Florida.
body_markdown:
# Acadia To Participate in UBS Global Healthcare Conference


Posted on


[November](https://www.acadiahealthcare.com/about/news-media-events/2025/11/)[10](https://www.acadiahealthcare.com/about/news-media-events/2025/11/10/) ,[2025](https://www.acadiahealthcare.com/about/news-media-events/2025/)


by


[Acadia Healthcare](https://www.acadiahealthcare.com/about/news-media-events/author/acadia-healthcare)


Acadia Healthcare will participate in a fireside chat during the UBS Global Healthcare Conference, which is taking place November 9-12. The conference is being held in Palm Beach Gardens, Florida, and Acadia’s presentation will be available starting at 1:45 p.m. Central time on Tuesday, November 11. The webcast can be viewed on our[Investors page](https://www.acadiahealthcare.com/investors/) .
